दिगन्त दिग्-अन्त, दिग्-अन्तर, दिग्-अम्बर.
See under the compounds of 2. दिश्.

दिग्ध दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. दिह्),
smeared, anointed, plastered; soiled, polluted, defiled;
(अस्), m. oil, ointment, unguent, oily substance; a
name of fire; a poisoned arrow; a tale true or false.
—दिग्ध-सह-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, lying in the
midst of mud (?).
—दिग्ध-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having
the hands smeared or soiled.
—दिग्धाङ्ग (˚ध-
अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having the limbs anointed.
